newsitem.title: USA: Bankers Trust names Ferrell to risk unit.
newsitem.headline: Bankers Trust names Ferrell to risk unit.

text.p: Bankers Trust New York Corp said it hired Kevin Ferrell, formerly chief financial officer at McKesson Corp, to be a managing director and head of its risk management advisory business.
Bankers Trust said Ferrell will head the group that assists clients in measuring and analyzing the risks inherent in their businesses.
Ferrell will also be responsible for client coverage in the oil and gas industry group.
Bankers Trust said Ferrell will report jointly to Rodney McLauchlan and Yves de Balmann. McLauchlan, based in New York, is responsible for the firm's client development efforts.

Based in London, de Balmann serves as chairman of Bankers Trust Internatioinal and has overall responsibility for the firm's risk management services group. McLauchlan and de Balmann also manage the company's investment banking business.
